primary_model: V3 species-wide forcing + frozen trait-adjustment blocks + A + H + A:H loading model

permutation.scheme: Within each species and frozen trait-adjustment block, permute the complete site-trait tuple (A,H,A:H) among site time series. Singleton blocks remain fixed. Refit the complete V3 process/loading model for every permutation, including shared forcing, site drift, process SD, block intercepts and residual loadings. Observation nuisance calibration is held fixed because it is trait-independent.
permutation.p_value: (1 + number of permuted gamma_AH <= observed gamma_AH)/(B+1)

multiple_species.adjustment: Holm adjustment across ADPE, CHPE and GEPE primary gamma_AH permutation p-values
multiple_species.generality_wording: A cross-species replicated crossover is claimed only if all three gamma_AH estimates are negative; species-specific adjusted p-values are reported rather than selecting a favorable species subset.

crossover_classification.rule: Use the option-fragmentation crossover label only when gamma_AH<0, low-area H slope >=0, and high-area H slope <0. A significant interaction without both marginal-slope signs is described as scale-dependent heterogeneity rather than crossover.

secondary_models: A-only, H-only and R-only effects use the same V3 loading engine and frozen spatial adjustment.
A+H+R+A:H combined model is secondary synthesis only.
mu/site-drift associations are secondary and cannot replace a null lambda result.
terminal_rules: Do not change permutation blocks, sidedness, B, or species multiplicity rule after counts are opened.
Do not permute across geographic adjustment blocks.
Do not condition permutations on the observed sign or p-value.
No post-outcome species subset becomes primary.
